name: context-menu-21
description: A context menu with controlled open state that reports when it opens and closes.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { LayoutGrid as LayoutGridIcon, Plus as PlusIcon, RefreshCw as RefreshCwIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/context-menu" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" export default function ControlledOpenMenu() { const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false) const [opens, setOpens] = React.useState(0) return (
{ setOpen(next) if (next) setOpens((n) => n + 1) }} > Right-click the dashboard canvas Add widget Auto-arrange Refresh all
Menu is {open ? "open" : "closed"} Opened {opens}×
) }
